criterion: which domain of everyday assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Information Query
categories.definition: Requests for factual information, definitions, calculations, conversions, or general knowledge.

categories.name: News & Current Events
categories.definition: Requests for general news, headlines, or specific updates on ongoing events or topics.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Inquiries about current weather conditions, forecasts, or weather-related advice.

categories.name: Music & Audio Playback
categories.definition: Commands to play, control, or manage music, podcasts, radio, or other audio content.

categories.name: Calendar & Reminders
categories.definition: Creating, modifying, checking, or deleting calendar events, alarms, or reminders.

categories.name: Lists & Notes
categories.definition: Creating, checking, modifying, or deleting various types of lists (e.g., shopping, to-do) or notes.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Sending, checking, or replying to emails, text messages, or social media posts, and managing contacts.

categories.name: Smart Home & Device Control
categories.definition: Commands to control smart home devices (lights, appliances) or general device settings (volume, power).

categories.name: Navigation & Travel
categories.definition: Requests for directions, public transport information, or booking travel services (taxis, trains).

categories.name: App Management
categories.definition: Commands to open, close, or interact with specific applications.

categories.name: Jokes & Entertainment
categories.definition: Requests for jokes or general entertainment content.

categories.name: Time & Date
categories.definition: Inquiries about current time, date, or time zone conversions.

categories.name: Personal Well-being
categories.definition: Commands or queries related to personal health, diet, or self-improvement goals.

categories.name: Shopping & Local Services
categories.definition: Finding stores, ordering products/food, checking prices, locating local services, or checking order status.

categories.name: General Conversation
categories.definition: Casual chat, greetings, expressing feelings, or open-ended conversational prompts not seeking specific information or action.

categories.name: Productivity & Planning
categories.definition: Requests for assistance with planning, organizing, analyzing ideas, or executing routines.

categories.name: General Notification
categories.definition: A general request to be alerted or notified, without specifying the type of event or reminder.
